name: Teresa
source:
When she was young her parents went missing and she was taken in by the family of a friend of hers.
That family had a son named [url=/c43966]Runo[/url] and her and him got along like siblings.
When Runo goes missing she goes chasing him down and ends up working together with a group of knights.
